062/**
063 *
064 * @param <T> the parameter type
065 * @author jimmy
066 */
067public abstract class IrRewriter<T>
068        implements IrIntExprVisitor<T, IrIntExpr>,
069        IrSetExprVisitor<T, IrSetExpr>,
070        IrStringExprVisitor<T, IrStringExpr>,
071        IrIntArrayExprVisitor<T, IrIntArrayExpr>,
072        IrSetArrayExprVisitor<T, IrSetArrayExpr> {
073
074    protected static <T> boolean changed(T t1, T t2) {
075        if (t1 == t2) {
076            return false;
077        }
078        assert !t1.equals(t2) : "Likely not optimized, the rewriter duplicated an object. Possible false negative.";
079        return true;
080    }
081
082    protected static <T> boolean changed(T[] t1, T[] t2) {
083        if (t1 == t2) {
084            return false;
085        }
086        if (t1.length != t2.length) {
087            return true;
088        }
089        for (int i = 0; i < t1.length; i++) {
090            if (changed(t1[i], t2[i])) {
091                return true;
092            }
093        }
094        return false;
095    }
096
097    protected static <T> boolean changed(T[][] t1, T[][] t2) {
098        if (t1 == t2) {
099            return false;
100        }
101        if (t1.length != t2.length) {
102            return true;
103        }
104        for (int i = 0; i < t1.length; i++) {
105            if (changed(t1[i], t2[i])) {
106                return true;
107            }
108        }
109        return false;
110    }
111
112    public IrModule rewrite(IrModule module, T t) {
113        IrModule optModule = new IrModule(module.getConstraints().size());
114        for (IrBoolExpr constraint : module.getConstraints()) {
115            optModule.addConstraint(rewrite(constraint, t));
116        }
117        return optModule;
118    }
119
120    public IrBoolExpr rewrite(IrBoolExpr expr, T t) {
121        return (IrBoolExpr) expr.accept(this, t);
122    }
123
124    public IrBoolExpr[] rewrite(IrBoolExpr[] exprs, T t) {
125        IrBoolExpr[] rewritten = new IrBoolExpr[exprs.length];
126        for (int i = 0; i < rewritten.length; i++) {
127            rewritten[i] = rewrite(exprs[i], t);
128        }
129        return rewritten;
130    }
131
132    public IrIntExpr rewrite(IrIntExpr expr, T t) {
133        return expr.accept(this, t);
134    }
135
136    public IrIntExpr[] rewrite(IrIntExpr[] exprs, T t) {

139            rewritten[i] = rewrite(exprs[i], t);
140        }
141        return rewritten;
142    }
143

145        IrIntExpr[][] rewritten = new IrIntExpr[exprs.length][];
146        for (int i = 0; i < rewritten.length; i++) {
147            rewritten[i] = rewrite(exprs[i], t);
148        }
149        return rewritten;
150    }

200    @Override
201    public IrIntExpr visit(IrRegister ir, T a) {
202        IrVar variable = ir.getVariable();
203        if (variable instanceof IrBoolVar) {
204            variable = (IrVar) rewrite((IrBoolVar) variable, a);
205        } else if (variable instanceof IrIntVar) {
206            variable = (IrVar) rewrite((IrIntVar) variable, a);
207        } else if (variable instanceof IrSetVar) {
208            variable = (IrVar) rewrite((IrSetVar) variable, a);
209        } else {
210            variable = (IrVar) rewrite((IrStringVar) variable, a);
211        }
212        return changed(ir.getVariable(), variable)
213                ? new IrRegister(variable)
214                : ir;
215    }

218    public IrBoolVar visit(IrBoolVar ir, T a) {
219        return ir;
220    }

225        return changed(ir.getExpr(), expr)
226                ? not(expr)
227                : ir;
228    }

262    @Override
263    public IrBoolExpr visit(IrIfThenElse ir, T a) {
264        IrBoolExpr antecedent = rewrite(ir.getAntecedent(), a);
265        IrBoolExpr consequent = rewrite(ir.getConsequent(), a);
266        IrBoolExpr alternative = rewrite(ir.getAlternative(), a);
267        return changed(ir.getAntecedent(), antecedent)
268                || changed(ir.getConsequent(), consequent)
269                || changed(ir.getAlternative(), alternative)
270                        ? ifThenElse(antecedent, consequent, alternative)
271                        : ir;
272    }

278        return changed(ir.getLeft(), left) || changed(ir.getRight(), right)
279                ? ifOnlyIf(left, right)
280                : ir;

653    @Override
654    public IrSetExpr visit(IrOffset ir, T a) {
655        IrSetExpr set = rewrite(ir.getSet(), a);
656        return changed(ir.getSet(), set)
657                ? offset(set, ir.getOffset())
658                : ir;
659    }
660
661    @Override
662    public IrSetExpr visit(IrMask ir, T a) {
663        IrSetExpr set = rewrite(ir.getSet(), a);
664        return changed(ir.getSet(), set)
665                ? mask(set, ir.getFrom(), ir.getTo())
666                : ir;
667    }

669    @Override
670    public IrSetExpr visit(IrSetTernary ir, T a) {
671        IrBoolExpr antecedent = rewrite(ir.getAntecedent(), a);
672        IrSetExpr consequent = rewrite(ir.getConsequent(), a);
673        IrSetExpr alternative = rewrite(ir.getAlternative(), a);
674        return changed(ir.getAntecedent(), antecedent)
675                || changed(ir.getConsequent(), consequent)
676                || changed(ir.getAlternative(), alternative)
677                        ? ternary(antecedent, consequent, alternative)
678                        : ir;
679    }

681    @Override
682    public IrSetExpr visit(IrContainsSetTernary ir, T a) {
683        IrSetExpr antecedent = rewrite(ir.getAntecedent(), a);
684        IrSetExpr consequent = rewrite(ir.getConsequent(), a);
685        return changed(ir.getAntecedent(), antecedent)
686                || changed(ir.getConsequent(), consequent)
687                        ? containsTernary(antecedent, ir.getX(), consequent)
688                        : ir;
689    }

691    @Override
692    public IrStringVar visit(IrStringVar ir, T a) {
693        IrIntVar[] chars = Util.<IrIntVar>cast(rewrite(ir.getCharVars(), a));
694        IrIntVar length = (IrIntVar) rewrite(ir.getLengthVar(), a);
695        return changed(ir.getCharVars(), chars)
696                || changed(ir.getLengthVar(), length)
697                        ? string(ir.getName(), chars, length)
698                        : ir;
699    }

701    @Override
702    public IrStringExpr visit(IrConcat ir, T a) {
703        IrStringExpr left = rewrite(ir.getLeft(), a);
704        IrStringExpr right = rewrite(ir.getRight(), a);
705        return changed(ir.getLeft(), left) || changed(ir.getRight(), right)
706                ? concat(left, right)
707                : ir;
708    }

711    public IrStringExpr visit(IrStringElement ir, T a) {
712        IrStringExpr[] array = rewrite(ir.getArray(), a);
713        IrIntExpr index = rewrite(ir.getIndex(), a);
714        return changed(ir.getArray(), array) || changed(ir.getIndex(), index)
715                ? element(array, index)
716                : ir;
717    }

719    @Override
720    public IrIntArrayExpr visit(IrIntArrayVar ir, T a) {
721        IrIntExpr[] array = rewrite(ir.getArray(), a);
722        return changed(ir.getArray(), array)
723                ? array(array)
724                : ir;

727    @Override
728    public IrIntArrayExpr visit(IrSubarray ir, T a) {
729        IrIntArrayExpr array = rewrite(ir.getArray(), a);
730        IrIntExpr index = rewrite(ir.getIndex(), a);
731        IrIntExpr sublength = rewrite(ir.getSublength(), a);
732        return changed(array, ir.getArray()) || changed(index, ir.getIndex()) || changed(sublength, ir.getSublength())
733                ? subarray(array, index, sublength)
734                : ir;
735    }

737    @Override
738    public IrSetArrayExpr visit(IrSetArrayVar ir, T a) {
739        IrSetExpr[] array = rewrite(ir.getArray(), a);
740        return changed(ir.getArray(), array)
741                ? array(array)
742                : ir;

745    @Override
746    public IrSetArrayExpr visit(IrInverse ir, T a) {
747        IrSetArrayExpr relation = rewrite(ir.getRelation(), a);
748        return changed(ir.getRelation(), relation)
749                ? inverse(relation, ir.getEnvs().length)
750                : ir;
751    }

753    @Override
754    public IrSetArrayExpr visit(IrTransitiveClosure ir, T a) {
755        IrSetArrayExpr relation = rewrite(ir.getRelation(), a);
756        return changed(ir.getRelation(), relation)
757                ? transitiveClosure(relation, ir.isReflexive())
758                : ir;
759    }

761    @Override
762    public IrIntExpr visit(IrConnected ir, T a) {
763        IrSetExpr nodes = rewrite(ir.getNodes(), a);
764        IrSetArrayExpr edges = rewrite(ir.getRelation(), a);
765        return changed(ir.getNodes(), nodes) || changed(ir.getRelation(), edges)
766                ? connected(nodes, edges, ir.isDirected())
767                : ir;
768    }
